interpretation: The cos(12θ) correction term E provides a continuous, smooth dial that brings wing/arm through 2.0 and through the predicted P1 anomalous value 2 - α/(2π). The local sensitivity (dr/dE) is order unity, so an E perturbation of ~5e-7 separates the electron and muon predictions. This confirms STRUCTURAL CAPACITY of the BOK harmonic basis to encode QED-scale anomalous corrections — it does NOT derive them from first principles. Derivation would require linking E to the fine-structure constant via an independent framework principle (open research question, target of URB #704).
